append.detail: CLOSED 2026-10-19. PREMISE RE-TESTED on main: the bootstrap config and the in-app page_view set page_location only, and the Vercel beforeSend kept the query string. FIX: pixelSafeTitle (lib/analytics/sanitize.ts) returns the generic REDACTED_PAGE_TITLE wherever pixelSafePath redacts the path. The GA bootstrap passes page_title in its config and gtag('set') for every later hit on the page; the in-app page_view (components/analytics/track-provider.tsx) does the same on each route change; the Vercel beforeSend drops the query string and hash. Tests: lib/consent/cookie-consent.test.ts runs the real head script on /journeys/grief-walks and reads the config and set calls; lib/analytics/sanitize.test.ts; components/analytics/vercel-analytics.test.tsx.
